name: Jacket - Ocho Extracts Airplane Mode Letterman
description:
*Runs small, so order a size above!

The OCHO Letterman Jacket blends classic varsity styling with premium everyday comfort. Made from a heavyweight ring spun cotton blend, this jacket features a soft cotton-faced fabric for a clean, elevated feel.

Designed with striped knitted collar, cuffs, and waistband detailing, the piece delivers a timeless athletic-inspired look with modern streetwear versatility. Finished with press-stud button closures, a taped back neck, this jacket combines comfort, style, and practicality in one staple layer.

Features:• 9.8 oz. heavyweight fabric• 80% ring spun cotton / 20% polyester blend• Soft cotton-faced finish• Striped knitted collar, cuffs, and waistband• Press-stud button closure• Taped back neck for comfort• Classic varsity-inspired styling
